newsitem.title: EGYPT: Gunmen kill two policemen in southern Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill two policemen in southern Egypt.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen shot dead two police conscripts and wounded two people when they opened fire at a checkpoint in southern Egypt on Thursday, the Interior Ministry said.

A ministry statement said the incident took place in el-Mughalqa village near Mallawi, about 260 km (160 miles) south of Cairo. Mallawi, in Minya province, has been the centre of activity of Moslem militants for two years.

Conscripts Ga'afar Dessouki Mohammed and Nasser Dessouki Abdel-Tawab were killed in the shooting in the early hours of Thursday. Another conscript and a civilian passerby were wounded, the statement said.

More than 1,000 people, mainly militants and policemen, have been killed in political violence in Egypt since militants took up arms in 1992 to overthrow the government and set up a strict Islamic state.
